question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Probably**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Probably **is an adverb that indicates a high likelihood or a strong possibility of something happening. (संभवतया)
 
• It suggests a level of uncertainty but a greater chance of occurrence.
 
 
• **Example**: *It looks like rain clouds are gathering, so it will probably rain later in the evening.*
